name: The Group's financial and Hive code descends from computer systems and its upstream
asks: Leader utterances of 2026-09-11 to 2026-09-25 (pass general-1): everything in the financial systems is specialized from computer systems; the financial knowledge and technology of the 561 Group is platformized; the Hive code is made downstream of the primitive ecosystem and carries no limit that stops the Group curating or trading.

x-provenance.recorded-by: general-1 pass of debt-2026-10-09-leader-words-held-in-corpus (Red Cup Engineer Senior)
x-provenance.basis: Leader utterances cited by address; the requirements are an EARS rendering of what those words state and carry no scope the words do not.

board-opening.need: Leader utterances of 2026-09-11 to 2026-09-25 (pass general-1): everything in the financial systems is specialized from computer systems; the financial knowledge and technology of the 561 Group is platformized; the Hive code is made downstream of the primitive ecosystem and carries no limit that stops the Group curating or trading.

requirements.says: The financial systems of the Group shall be specializations of computer systems and its upstream engines, and no financial system shall be handrolled.
requirements.rationale: Leader, 2026-09-11 20:39: "EVERYTHING in financial-systems should be specialized from computer-systems and its upstream, rather than be handrolled. Not just that one thing you identified."

requirements.says: The financial knowledge and technology of the 561 Group shall be platformized, standardized, architecturalized and semantically and syntactically deduplicated toward the typed classes and shared functions of the ecosystem.
requirements.rationale: Leader, 2026-09-12 00:52 and 03:03: "platformization, standardization, architecturalization, semantic deduplication, syntactic deduplication, and other such izations and ications done to the 561 Group's financial knowledge and technology".

requirements.says: The Group's economics, business and finance knowledge and technology shall be developed ambitiously as early-alpha work of one developer.
requirements.rationale: Leader, 2026-09-12 02:02: "Let's find more stuff in our economics/business/finance knowledge and technology to keep working on. Everything here is early alpha being done by one dev, be ambitious."

requirements.says: The Group's Hive code shall be downstream of the primitive ecosystem, the Sign family included.
requirements.rationale: Leader, 2026-09-25 16:31: "invest heavily in discovering everything we have related to doing stuff on the Hive blockchain ... to start getting that code to be downstream of our more primitive ecosystem".

requirements.says: The Hive code shall hold only the importers that its design needs, the others being consumers that duplicate the effort.
requirements.rationale: Leader, 2026-09-25 16:51: "How many of those importers actually need to exist, though? ... it's likely that those consumers are not all meant to duplicate this effort".

requirements.says: The Hive code shall carry no hardcoded limit that inhibits the Group from curating or trading with it.
requirements.rationale: Leader, 2026-09-25 22:47: "weird hardcoded limits ... basically inhibit our ability to actually ever curate or trade with our Hive code. We don't want any of that."

requirements.says: The Hive key custody shall keep every key outside every record of the corpus and shall not delete a key as a security measure without a recorded recovery.
requirements.rationale: Leader, 2026-09-25 23:12: "I guess you deleted the keys as a 'security measure' at some point"; the Group's rule on credentials forbids any key in a file.
